git add -A && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Add --threshold option to frai eval for CI gating

Implements threshold support for evaluation metrics so CI pipelines can fail
when metric scores fall below specified minimums. This completes the feature
request to gate CI jobs on evaluation results.

CLI Changes:
- frai eval --threshold <metric>=<min> (repeatable, e.g., exact_match=0.9)
- Exit 1 if any threshold fails, 0 if all pass
- Exit 2 for usage errors (malformed thresholds, unknown metrics)
- Thresholds with no score (null) fail instead of crashing

SDK Changes (frai-core):
- generateReport() accepts optional thresholds parameter
- Works for custom metrics passed to runEvaluations
- Validation ensures metric IDs exist and values are 0-1

Reports:
- JSON: adds top-level 'passed' field and 'thresholds' array
  - Each threshold: { metric, min, score, passed }
- Markdown: adds "Thresholds" section showing PASS/FAIL status

Backward compatible: without --threshold, behavior unchanged.

Tests: added 5 new tests covering pass, fail, null score, and validation cases.

Documentation: updated README with usage examples and option descriptions.
EOF
)" && git log -1 --oneline
